1879213910.name: Exposed (Melee)

1879218262.name: Improved Quick Shot
1879218262.desc: Nock and loose an arrow quickly.\n\nHas a chance to generate additional Focus.

1879282902.desc: Puny attempts to slay you can be shrugged off with a mighty cry.

1879329366.name: White Squirrel

1879344470.name: Majestic White Stag

1879447382.name: Fireworks Corgi

1879467734.name: Salt-sea Blade

1879506646.name: Gift of the Rime
